name: The Agency: Chapter 1
source:
“The Agency” is a Steampunk Mystery Visual Novel & Puzzle Game. Follow in the steps of Inspector Beckwith, a junior detective in the “Silver Wings Detective Agency”, as he gets embroiled in an investigation that will turn his whole world upside down and take him on the adventure of a lifetime! 

The game features: 
- A thrilling mystery storyline 
- High quality anime art 
- Brilliant steampunk inspired music 
- An addictive puzzle mini game 
- Fantastic steampunk style and theme
